events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw four touchdown passes, and the injury-riddled Green Bay Packers converted three turnovers into scores in an eventful 35-14 victory over the mistake-prone Chicago Bears on Thursday night.

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: It took Drew Brees and the New Orleans Saints six days and a first half before they finally found their footing in soggy Britain.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints' second half propels them to shutout win vs. Dolphins

headlines.description: Stephen Hauschka kicked a tiebreaking, 56-yard field goal with less than 5 minutes remaining and the Buffalo Bills made a last-minute defensive stand to beat Atlanta 23-17 on Sunday after the Falcons lost wide receiver Julio Jones to a hip injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hauschka's 2 late FGs lift Bills past Falcons, 23-17

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw three of his four touchdown passes in the first half and Cincinnati's offense found the perfect opponent to work out some early-season struggles and the Bengals rolled to a 31-7 win on Sunday over the overmatched Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton throws 4 TD passes, Bengals blow out Browns 31-7

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Todd Gurley scored the go-ahead touchdown on a 53-yard catch-and-run, Greg Zuerlein kicked a career-high seven field goals and the Los Angeles Rams beat the Dallas Cowboys 35-30 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gurley, Rams continue strong start, rally past Cowboys 35-30

headlines.description: Anthony Zettel led a ferocious performance by Detroit's defense with two sacks, four hurries and a fumble recovery, as the Lions forced three turnovers while holding Minnesota scoreless in the second half on the way to a 14-7 victory over the Vikings...
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominant defense leads Lions to 14-7 victory over Vikings

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Graham Gano hit a 48-yard field goal as time expired, and the Carolina Panthers stunned the New England Patriots 33-30 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gano field goal lifts Panthers over Patriots 33-30

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at New York Jets

headlines.description: Chandler Catanzaro kicked a 41-yard field goal with 28 seconds left in overtime, lifting the New York Jets to a wacky 23-20 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Catanzaro's FG leads Jets to wacky 23-20 OT win over Jaguars

headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers finally got their offense running. The wait continues for the Baltimore Ravens.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bell, Steelers run over Ravens 26-9 in first-place duel

headlines.description: Rookie Deshaun Watson shined, throwing for four touchdowns and running for another as the Houston Texans scored the most points in franchise history in a 57-14 walloping of the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson accounts for 5 TDs as Texans down Titans 57-14

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw 19 yards to Larry Fitzgerald with 32 seconds left in overtime for the game's only touchdown and the Arizona Cardinals escaped with an 18-15 victory over the winless San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer's TD toss to Fitzgerald beats 49ers in OT

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Carson Wentz passed for 242 yards, LeGarrette Blount rushed for 136 and the Philadelphia Eagles extended their promising start to the season with a 26-24 victory over the winless Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blount drives Eagles to 26-24 victory over winless Chargers

events.name: New York Giants at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw for 332 yards and three touchdowns without an interception, and Nick Folk kicked a 34-yard field goal as time expired to give the Tampa Bay Buccaneers a 25-23 victory over the winless New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Folk redeems himself with 34-yard FG to beat Giants 25-23

headlines.description: The Denver Broncos throttled running back Marshawn Lynch and sent quarterback Derek Carr to the sideline with a back injury, then sealed their 16-10 win over Oakland on Sunday on safety Justin Simmons'  interception of EJ Manuel in the closing minutes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Denver Broncos hold on for a 16-10 win over Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: It took a trio of relative unknowns to wake up the Seattle Seahawks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks use huge 2nd-half surge to rout Colts 46-18

events.name: Washington Redskins at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Chiefs kicker Harrison Butker drilled a 43-yard field goal with 8 seconds left in his first career game, atoning for an earlier miss and helping Kansas City to a 29-20 victory over the Washington Redskins on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Butker's field goals send Chiefs to 29-20 win over Redskins
